result.markdown:
# South Region Traffic Drop Due to Fiber Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SUD-02-A`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of fiber link loss matching site outages and traffic drop onset. Maintenance calendar and external events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-24 14:30 to 2026-09-24 21:48
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-24 14:42
- **Affected:** S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003, LNK-SUD-02-A

## Summary

Fiber link loss on LNK-SUD-02-A severed connectivity to sites S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003, causing a complete drop in availability and traffic.

Traffic and availability dropped to zero for sites S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 starting at 2026-09-24 14:30 and recovering at 21:48.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-24 13:41: Parameter tuning change applied on S-SUD-001. [CHG-2026-0081]
- 2026-09-24 14:30: Regional alert ALR-0034 started and availability dropped below baseline. [ALR-0034, T6]
- 2026-09-24 14:42: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on fiber link LNK-SUD-02-A. [ALM-000569]
- 2026-09-24 14:43: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003. [ALM-000570, ALM-000571]
- 2026-09-24 14:45: Traffic volume and availability reached zero on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003. [T6]
- 2026-09-24 21:46: Fiber link alarm cleared on LNK-SUD-02-A. [ALM-000569]
- 2026-09-24 21:48: Site down alarms cleared on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003. [ALM-000570, ALM-000571]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 both depend on the shared fiber link LNK-SUD-02-A. [T4, T7]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-SUD-02-A at 2026-09-24 14:42. [ALM-000569]
- Sites S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 experienced SITE_DOWN alarms starting at 2026-09-24 14:43. [ALM-000570, ALM-000571]
- Availability and DL volume dropped to zero across both S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-003 starting at 2026-09-24 14:30/14:45. [T6]
- A parameter tuning change occurred on S-SUD-001 at 2026-09-24 13:41. [CHG-2026-0081]

## Inferences

- Simultaneous outage of sibling sites under LNK-SUD-02-A indicates a shared transport failure rather than a single-site configuration change. [T3, T5, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-02-A: confirmed. Fiber link loss alarm perfectly matched the timing of simultaneous availability and traffic drops on both dependent sites. [ALM-000569, T6]
2. **bad_change** at S-SUD-001: rejected. Parameter change on S-SUD-001 cannot account for the simultaneous outage of its sibling site S-SUD-003 on the same transport link. [CHG-2026-0081, T7]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0081: Ruled out because the change was isolated to S-SUD-001, whereas S-SUD-003 suffered an identical simultaneous outage via the shared transport link.
- ALR-0037: Ongoing alert relates to different sites (S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005) and a later time period starting 2026-09-25 09:30.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SUD-02-A physical path for transient or intermittent loss causes.
- Review maintenance calendar records for the affected window to formally rule out planned works.
- Verify redundancy paths for AGG-SUD-02 uplinks to prevent dual-site isolation.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0081`: parameter_tuning on S-SUD-001 at 2026-09-24 13:41: Handover hysteresis fine-tuning on S-SUD-001
- `ALR-0034`: ended alert from 2026-09-24 14:30: 2 site(s) (S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003); region-level SUD; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb, latency_ms
- `T6`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-SUD-001', 'S-SUD-003'], metrics=['dl_volume_mb', 'availability_pct'], start=2026-09-24 12:00:00, end=2026- -> Deviation in 4 of 4 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-24 14:30: S-SUD-001 availability_pct below baseline.
- `ALM-000569`: critical LINK_LOS on LNK-SUD-02-A, raised 2026-09-24 14:42, cleared 2026-09-24 21:46
- `ALM-000570`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-001, raised 2026-09-24 14:43, cleared 2026-09-24 21:48
- `ALM-000571`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-003, raised 2026-09-24 14:43, cleared 2026-09-24 21:48
- `T4`: get_topology(node_id=S-SUD-001, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SUD-001 (site) -> LNK-SUD-02-A (fiber link) -> AGG-SUD-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-02 (core upf)
- `T7`: get_topology(node_id=S-SUD-003, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SUD-003 (site) -> LNK-SUD-02-A (fiber link) -> AGG-SUD-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-02 (core upf)
- `T3`: get_changes(start=2026-09-24 12:00:00, end=2026-09-24 18:00:00, node_ids=['S-SUD-001', 'S-SUD-003'], include_ancestors=True) -> 1 change(s) on S-SUD-001, S-SUD-003 and its parents, 2026-09-24 12:00 to 2026-09-24 18:00 (0 on upstream nodes, 0 rolled back by asked_at 2026-09-25 09:41).
- `T5`: get_alarms(start=2026-09-24 12:00:00, end=2026-09-24 18:00:00, node_ids=['LNK-SUD-02-A', 'AGG-SUD-02'], include_descendants=True, min_severity=major) -> 3 alarm(s) on LNK-SUD-02-A, AGG-SUD-02 and nodes below: 3 critical; 0 active. - `ALR-0037`: ongoing alert from 2026-09-25 09:30: 2 site(s) (S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005); metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
